thread:
Maya (CS): Heads-up: Meridian go-live 10am PST tomorrow. They expect bursts and have renewal in ~30d. Need a one-page customer runbook: prefill, streaming fallback, batching hints, escalation and a tiny paste-snippet.
Jon (Eng): Which route/model?
Maya (CS): `meridian-live-gen`, gpt-4o-slim-v2, seq usually 256, spikes to 1024 for demos.
Priya (SE): Recommend prefill_ttl=900s, batch_window_ms=20, stream_chunk=200 tokens. Enforce prompt filter to strip PII before prefill.
Priya (SE): Paste snippet (<=8 lines):
```
prefill_ttl:900
batch_window_ms:20
stream_chunk_tokens:200
fallback_policy:stream_on_queue>500ms
prompt_filters:[strip_pii]
```
Ava (Data): Telemetry keys: prefill_hit, prefill_miss, stream_fallback_count, avg_latency_ms, queue_depth. Add tenant_stage and renewal_window_days=30. We'll tag renewal_risk and send webhook to cs-alerts.
Liam (PM): If renewal_signal_score<0.4 auto-trigger CS outreach + demo. Ava: include renewal_risk:high|med|low and reason list.
Jon (Eng): Escalation snippet: if rejection_rate>2% AND queue_depth>200 -> page eng-oncall with runbook link. Weekend oncall handles triage.
Priya (SE): Will add 5 quality prompts (happy, long-context, adversarial, correction, tool-call) for regression checks. Gist link: https://gist.github.com/example/meridian-prompts
deploy-bot: [deploy] prefill-config rolled to prod (prefill-2026-04-06).
Maya (CS): Thanks all. I'll assemble the one-pager and send it to Meridian in morning sync. Drop edits here tonight if needed.
